reviews.title: Subdivisions behind a paywall now?
reviews.text: Come on. I’m uninstalling right now.

reviews.title: Crazy battery drain from running in background
reviews.text: The functionality of the app is good but after using it for 15 minutes, it continued to run in the background for over 13 hours (not playing any sound or anything that would tell me it's running) even after I turned off background app refresh. It used 60% of my battery (30% before charging and another 30% after charging). This makes the app unusable to me and I had to delete it.

reviews.title: Disgusted Why the charge?
reviews.text: I have been using this app for years and always relied on its accessibility and the fact that it is user friendly- and now you’re charging for subdivision?! I may be late to the game, but I’ll just go back to my doctor beat and call it good, before I spend the $ for subdivision in an app.

reviews.title: Subscription for a metronome
reviews.text: Subscription for a metronome - ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha!!! 🤣 (deleted with a minute).

reviews.title: disappointed at a very simple coding mistake
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to practice high level rhythm training. I was looking to count continuous 16th notes while having the metronome play only beat 1 & 3 but for some reason this app doesn’t play the downbeat of a rhythm if the previous beat is blank. if all the beats are activated it will play the down beats correctly, but if I have beat 2 & 4 play blank, then the down beat of 1 & 3 is gone, it simple plays the “e-&-a” not the “1-e-&-a.” very disappointed, I discovered this after purchasing annual subscription for the sole purpose of training through blank beats. please update this ASAP, I know it’s a simple fix

reviews.title: Not as i thought
reviews.text: Main reason for my score I thought this app would vibrate through my Apple Watch giving me a notification of stroke but this only seems to work through the phone.
